{"action": "hold", "sizePct": 0, "stopPct": 3.0, "conviction": 0.33, "rationale": "RMETAUSDT is an earnings-catalyst setup with an empty signal set, so there is no independent edge to trade against. Price (669.12) sits only ~2% above sma20 (655.75) with a flat 5-day return (+0.44%) and ATR of 15.94 (~2.4% of price), i.e. a mildly constructive but non-decisive drift into a binary event. Earnings gaps in tokenized equity proxies are typically 2-3x ATR and can gap through stops, so event-risk-adjusted expectancy is negative without a pre-committed directional signal. I prefer to stand flat and let the print resolve rather than pay the event premium; if forced to act, only a sub-0.5% risk unit would be defensible.", "minorityOpinion": "A momentum/drift book would take a small long here: price above sma20, positive 5-day return, and constructive pre-earnings drift plus supportive mega-cap tech tape often continue through the print, with a stop ~1x ATR (16 pts, ~2.4%) below entry targeting a 2-3x ATR event move."}
